reviewed_head_sha.description: Exact full SHA of the reviewed PR head.

reviewed_base_sha.description: Exact full SHA of the reviewed base branch tip.

reviewed_merge_base_sha.description: Exact full SHA of the merge base used to produce the reviewed patch.

plan_provided.description: True when an implementation plan (plan.md) was part of the evidence. ARCH findings are only valid when true.

id.description: Stable identifier reused when the same finding remains open.

category.description: Use AC for any finding referenced by an explicit acceptance criterion marked PARTIAL or MISSING. Use ARCH for a deviation from the implementation plan that breaks a recorded contract or invariant (requires plan_provided). Use TEST for a missing or wrong test. Put security, correctness, or test details in that AC finding's evidence, or add separate category-specific findings.

severity.description: BLOCKER: production breakage or data loss on a realistic path, major exploit, or explicit requirement MISSING. HIGH: concrete bug on a common path, limited exploit, explicit requirement PARTIAL, plan deviation breaking an invariant, or the plan's primary test absent. MEDIUM: needs uncommon conditions, perf regression without visible impact, missing edge-case test, hardening. LOW: naming, style, cleanup. Only BLOCKER and HIGH block.

relevant_code.description: The exact lines at file:line, quoted verbatim from the reviewed head.

failure_mode.description: Why it is a problem: the mechanism, and which invariant, requirement, or plan item is violated.

reproduction.description: Concrete inputs or state that produce the wrong behavior. For AC/ARCH findings: the criterion or plan item and the evidence it is unmet.

minimal_fix.description: Proposed correction at that site. The reviewer never applies it.

source.description: Issue #N, PR body, plan.md, or inferred.

severity.description: Explicit MISSING must be BLOCKER; explicit PARTIAL must be HIGH or BLOCKER; COVERED and NA must be NONE.

finding_id.description: For an explicit criterion with PARTIAL or MISSING status, this must reference a finding whose category is AC. Otherwise use null.

architecture_summary.description: How the diff compares with the implementation plan's Proposed Fix, Files, and Side-Effects Trace, starting from the Implementation Report's diverged/unplanned items, and whether the plan's weakest assumption was confirmed or refuted. When plan_provided is false, state that the gate is not applicable.

security_categories_checked.description: For APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, or BLOCKED, include every enum value below exactly once. For INCONCLUSIVE, this may be empty when review could not complete.

defect_checklist.description: Every item must be checked with evidence for a conclusive verdict. A defect found under an item becomes a finding; the item's evidence names that finding id.

checked.description: True only when the item was actually examined against the diff and affected paths.

defect_found.description: True when the examination produced at least one finding; name its id in evidence.

evidence.description: What was examined and what was found, with file:line or finding ids.
